column8: Minidregg.Compiler.StreamCell.Append → Prop := fun request => request.topic.length ≤ Minidregg.Compiler.StreamCell.maxTopicBytes ∧ request.payload.length ≤ Minidregg.Compiler.StreamCell.maxPayloadBytes
List UInt8 → List UInt8 → Option Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.SubjectId → Option (ℕ × ℕ) → Minidregg.Compiler.StreamCell.Append

ℕ → Minidregg.Compiler.StreamCell.Binding → Prop := fun cellId x => match x with | Minidregg.Compiler.StreamCell.Binding.room => True | Minidregg.Compiler.StreamCell.Binding.topic stream => cellId = Minidregg.Compiler.StreamCell.topicHeadCellId stream
{motive : Minidregg.Compiler.StreamCell.Binding → Sort u} → (t : Minidregg.Compiler.StreamCell.Binding) → t.ctorIdx = 0 → motive Minidregg.Compiler.StreamCell.Binding.room → motive t

{motive : Minidregg.Compiler.StreamCell.Binding → Sort u} → (t : Minidregg.Compiler.StreamCell.Binding) → t.ctorIdx = 1 → ((stream : Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.Digest) → motive (Minidregg.Compiler.StreamCell.Binding.topic stream)) → motive t

ℕ → Minidregg.Compiler.StreamCell.EntryStore → Prop := fun cellId store => match Minidregg.Compiler.StreamCell.entryOf store with | Option.none => False | Option.some entry => cellId = Minidregg.Compiler.StreamCell.entryCellId entry.head entry.sequence ∧ 1 ≤ entry.sequence ∧ (entry.sequence = 1 ↔ entry.parent = Option.none) ∧ entry.record.entry.topic.length ≤ Minidregg.Compiler.StreamCell.maxTopicBytes

ℕ → Minidregg.Compiler.StreamCell.Head → Prop := fun cellId head => (head.count = 0 ↔ head.tail = Option.none) ∧ Minidregg.Compiler.StreamCell.Binding.At cellId head.binding ∧ match head.last with | Option.none => head.count = 0 | Option.some entry => entry.head = cellId ∧ entry.sequence = head.count ∧ head.tail = Option.some (Minidregg.Compiler.StreamCell.entryKey entry)
Minidregg.Compiler.StreamCell.Binding → ℕ → Option Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.Digest → Option Minidregg.Compiler.StreamCell.Entry → Minidregg.Compiler.StreamCell.Head

ℕ → Minidregg.Compiler.StreamCell.HeadStore → Prop := fun cellId store => match Minidregg.Compiler.StreamCell.headOf store with | Option.none => False | Option.some head => Minidregg.Compiler.StreamCell.Head.Lawful cellId head
List UInt8 → Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.Digest → Option Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.SubjectId → Option (ℕ × ℕ) → Minidregg.Compiler.StreamCell.StreamEntry

∀ (headCell : ℕ) (head : Minidregg.Compiler.StreamCell.Head) (record : Minidregg.Compiler.StreamCell.StreamRecord), (head.count = 0 ↔ head.tail = Option.none) → record.entry.topic.length ≤ Minidregg.Compiler.StreamCell.maxTopicBytes → Minidregg.Compiler.StreamCell.EntryLaw (Minidregg.Compiler.StreamCell.entryCellId headCell head.nextSeq) (Minidregg.Compiler.StreamCell.entryStore (Minidregg.Compiler.StreamCell.appendEntry headCell head record))

∀ (headCell : ℕ) (head : Minidregg.Compiler.StreamCell.Head) (record : Minidregg.Compiler.StreamCell.StreamRecord), (Minidregg.Compiler.StreamCell.appendEntry headCell head record).sequence = head.count + 1 ∧ (Minidregg.Compiler.StreamCell.appendEntry headCell head record).parent = head.tail ∧ (head.append (Minidregg.Compiler.StreamCell.appendEntry headCell head record)).count = head.count + 1 ∧ (head.append (Minidregg.Compiler.StreamCell.appendEntry headCell head record)).tail = Option.some (Minidregg.Compiler.StreamCell.entryKey (Minidregg.Compiler.StreamCell.appendEntry headCell head record))

∀ (cellId : ℕ) (head : Minidregg.Compiler.StreamCell.Head) (record : Minidregg.Compiler.StreamCell.StreamRecord), (head.append (Minidregg.Compiler.StreamCell.appendEntry cellId head record)).last = Option.some (Minidregg.Compiler.StreamCell.appendEntry cellId head record) ∧ (head.append (Minidregg.Compiler.StreamCell.appendEntry cellId head record)).tail = Option.some (Minidregg.Compiler.StreamCell.entryKey (Minidregg.Compiler.StreamCell.appendEntry cellId head record))

∀ (cellId : ℕ) (head : Minidregg.Compiler.StreamCell.Head) (record : Minidregg.Compiler.StreamCell.StreamRecord), Minidregg.Compiler.StreamCell.Head.Lawful cellId head → Minidregg.Compiler.StreamCell.Head.Lawful cellId (head.append (Minidregg.Compiler.StreamCell.appendEntry cellId head record))

∀ (head : Minidregg.Compiler.StreamCell.Head) (entry : Minidregg.Compiler.StreamCell.Entry), Minidregg.Theory.Store.Op.Enabled (Minidregg.Compiler.StreamCell.headStore head) (Minidregg.Compiler.StreamCell.headWriteOp head entry)

∀ {cellId : ℕ} {head : Minidregg.Compiler.StreamCell.Head} {entry : Minidregg.Compiler.StreamCell.Entry}, Minidregg.Compiler.StreamCell.Head.Lawful cellId head → head.last = Option.some entry → entry.head = cellId ∧ entry.sequence = head.count ∧ head.tail = Option.some (Minidregg.Compiler.StreamCell.entryKey entry)

∀ (head : Minidregg.Compiler.StreamCell.Head) (first second : Minidregg.Compiler.StreamCell.Entry), ¬Minidregg.Theory.Store.Op.Enabled (Minidregg.Theory.Store.Op.apply (Minidregg.Compiler.StreamCell.headStore head) (Minidregg.Compiler.StreamCell.headWriteOp head first)) (Minidregg.Compiler.StreamCell.headWriteOp head second)

∀ {cellId : ℕ} {head : Minidregg.Compiler.StreamCell.Head} {entry : Minidregg.Compiler.StreamCell.Entry}, head.last = Option.some entry → head.tail ≠ Option.some (Minidregg.Compiler.StreamCell.entryKey entry) → ¬Minidregg.Compiler.StreamCell.Head.Lawful cellId head
